blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas was relegated to a battle for bronze in the men’s U-23 3×3 basketball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games after being manhandled by South Korea, 21-9, in Friday’s semifinals. Nic Cabanero, Luis Pablo, Koji Buenaflor and Doy Dungo never got their bearings after South Korea jumped to a 5-0 start and a lead of 8-1 during the contest held at Kinjo Futo Station Square. That left Gilas to play catch-up, but to no avail as hopes for a gold in the halfcourt competition were eventually dashed. The […]...
